text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Someone over here call for me?
You looking
for a challenge?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No one's here... Guess I'm just
hearing
things.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Or how about you, Three Goddesses?
Wanna
square up?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. If you were really here, I'm sure it'd
make for
one hell of a match.
